query.title: The query
query.text: Judge every image on the right against this query: an image, a text or both. The bar shows how many images are done.

image.title: Label a single image
image.text: The buttons under an image label just that image, also inside a labelled group.

image.title: Look closer
image.text: Compare the image with the query side by side, and see it among its group or the images most like it.

end.title: Judge, then review
end.text: Once every image has a label, Review shows them sorted by label to check and fix.

end.title: Image size
end.text: Fewer images per row make them bigger.

end.title: Next query
end.text: Moves on to your next unfinished query.

end.title: Tour
end.text: Starts this tour again, any time.

tabs.title: The steps of a study
tabs.text: Pilot and its results (optional, recommended), simulation, annotation, progress and results. Open any tab at any time.
